name: JN-66 analysis droid
description: The JN-66 analysis droid was a model of analysis droid used by the Jedi Temple's Analysis Rooms. JN-66 analysis droids had the same magnification and scanning abilities as SP-4 ISC units had with their optics and scanning visors.

data.name: JN-66 analysis droid
equipment: Fingers with olfactory and gustatory sensors
